description: Marshall Gerard (Sandra Gerard's son), Georgia O'Keeffe, Doris Bry, Kathy Porter (showed at Betty Parsons gallery), Eliott Porter, 'young man' (O'Keeffe named guide this), and Kenny Ross.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River'.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Others Loading the Raft
